title: X and TikTok publishers, off until switched on
items: New social_publish.py can post the week's content to X, with its studio graphic attached, and send the week's videos to TikTok as drafts for a person to finish in the app.

It is off by default: every weekly run prints the next post for each platform and sends nothing until the SOCIAL_PUBLISHING switch is turned on and the account keys are added. Setup steps are in docs/SOCIAL_PUBLISHING.md.

Each item posts once at most, never within 30 minutes of expiring, at most three a day per platform. A request with an unknown outcome pauses that platform until someone checks the account. Upset Watch posts now say 'Forecast, not betting advice'.
